entries.notes: Selected the exploratory principal components three-component TAS-20 solution in Table 7 because it is the only item-level factor/component-loading table for the TAS-20 in the paper. Components 1, 2, and 3 were mapped to F1, F2, and F3 by printed column order. All printed cross-loadings, negative loadings, and non-bold loadings were extracted; boldface was treated only as salience. Varimax is orthogonal, so off-diagonal factor correlations were set to 0 under the orthogonal EFA/PCA override. Tables 3 and 4 report observed Pearson correlations among total TAS-20/subscale scores rather than latent correlations for the selected PCA solution and were not extracted as factor correlations. Country was inferred from recruitment at the College of William and Mary in Virginia; language was inferred as English because no translation was mentioned. Sex/female percentage was not reported; demographic details were reported only for 69 of 99 participants, and no female percentage was visible.
